finalText:
Fixed. Root causes:

- `src/keys.js:7` — used local getters (`getFullYear`/`getMonth`/`getDate`), so an event at `2024-05-01T23:30Z` was bucketed as May 2 under any UTC+ offset. Now `getUTC*`.
- `src/range.js` — built local midnights and used local `setDate`, so `daysBetween` divided DST-shortened/lengthened days and floored wrong. Under `America/New_York` across spring-forward, `daysBetween('2024-03-09','2024-03-16')` returned 6 and `dayRange` dropped March 16 — the customer's missing day. Now `Date.UTC` + `getUTC*` + `setUTCDate`, making each day exactly 86,400,000 ms.

`npm test` passes 6/6.
